title: Noonline Route Kit
purpose: Make a future verified noon-route relation legible to a first-time user without requiring a phone, account, scan, personal data, daily line staffing or live AI.
first_use_script: Choose a fixed mode by symbol, number and words.
Follow the next physical marker only.
Use the pause, turn and status cards to continue, reroute, return or pause.
Use optional AI only after physical information; it cannot replace a marker or promote a condition.

modes.label: MOVE / brief walk
modes.use_boundary: A direction-first relation. It does not confirm a measured journey time or continuous service.

modes.label: PAUSE / brief stay
modes.use_boundary: May appear only where a stay opportunity, publicness and maintenance condition are verified. It does not confirm an existing seat, shade, water point or indoor space.

modes.label: ACCESS / accessibility first
modes.use_boundary: May appear only after a lawful, continuous accessible alternative is authorised and verified.

minimum_future_exercise.relationship: one authorised start - two decisions - one pause-information point - return
minimum_future_exercise.failure_rule: When any required check is missing, stale, rejected or unauditable, do not activate the affected component; remove it or keep it HOLD.

first_use_comprehension_test.purpose: Check whether a first-time reader can understand the physical information language before site activation. This is not a route, safety, accessibility, facility, service, permission or implementation test.

tasks.prompt: Choose a brief-walk mode from KIT-01 and KIT-02.
tasks.readable_response: The reader identifies the matching word, symbol and number.

tasks.prompt: Identify the next physical action from KIT-03.
tasks.readable_response: The reader matches the selected symbol and number to a direction word.

tasks.prompt: Bypass a pause choice and return using KIT-04.
tasks.readable_response: The reader identifies the visible RETURN rule without assuming a facility.

tasks.prompt: Respond to a changed relation using KIT-05 and KIT-06.
tasks.readable_response: The reader follows the named reroute marker rather than seeking a digital alert.

tasks.prompt: End the relation using the shared return rule.
tasks.readable_response: The reader identifies the known return relation without live AI or an on-site guide.

first_use_comprehension_test.failure_rule: An INCOMPLETE or UNCERTAIN result leaves the relevant component HOLD until its physical information is revised and rechecked. A COMPLETE result cannot release any separate publicness, legal, accessibility, safety, maintenance, permit or evidence requirement.

component_release_cards.not_appointed_interface: A future authorised maintenance and human-stop interface; no entity is appointed by this artifact.
component_release_cards.shared_release_rule: A component may move from HOLD only when its applicable authorisation, field evidence, physical legibility, maintenance interface and human stop authority are complete, current and auditable.

cards.failure_response: Cover or remove the panel; do not leave an ambiguous start.

cards.user_visible_next_action: Match a mode by word, symbol and number.
cards.failure_response: Keep the mode HOLD until wording and symbols are readable without colour alone.
Remove the marker or state RETURN when its relation cannot be maintained.
Remove the pause invitation when the related condition is not verified.
Show RETURN or remove the decision point when an alternate relation is unavailable.

cards.user_visible_next_action: Read CONTINUE, REROUTE, RETURN or PAUSE.
cards.failure_response: Set PAUSE and remove the affected relation when its status cannot be maintained.

prohibited_ai_role: automatic promotion of unknown or Verified SLA
